## Trace Your Catch

journey from fishing vessel to store shelf. Knowing where your food comes from is the first step
toward eating sustainably.

## Beyond the Ocean

With over a century of distribution experience, Ocean Beauty is proud to expand our offerings beyond
seafood. We now supply premium beef, pork, and poultry, bringing the same commitment to quality and
service that our customers have come to expect. Whether from land or sea, Ocean Beauty is your
partner in meeting diverse culinary needs. 

[Learn More][46]

## From Alaska, to the World.

Ocean Beauty has direct access to the top quality Alaska seafood that has always been at the heart
of our business. We also source products from the East Coast and around the world to offer a wide
array of customer favorites.

[View all Fresh & Frozen Seafood][47]
[Untitled design (14)]

## Creative Value-Added Seafood Solutions

In addition to a full line of fresh and frozen seafood, Ocean Beauty is committed to developing
products that makes selling seafood easy for retailers and simply delicious to prepare for
consumers. Our skin-packed portions and IQF seafood are ready for any recipe, and our creative meal
solutions pair top quality seafood with delicious accompaniments for easy meals in minutes.

[View Our Products][48]

## Distributing Seafood From Alaska and the World to Your Door

We operate seven wholesale distribution operations throughout the Western United States, and source
volumes of wild caught sustainable Alaska seafood through our sister company, OBI Seafoods.

[Find a Location Near You][49]
[Alaska-Pollock_S_P]

## Our Sustainability Commitment

We are dedicated to helping our customers meet their sustainability goals by producing products that
ensure healthy fish stocks, the environment that sustains them, and the communities that rely on
them.

[About Sustainability][50]
[icon-1]

### Committed to Quality

Whether it wears our label or yours, it’s our mission to deliver top quality seafood and value-added
products every time.

[About Quality ][51]
[icon-2]

### Sustaining Fisheries and Communities

All our facilities are eco-certified for a wide range of products from sustainable fisheries.

[About Sustainability ][52]
[icon-3]

### Ensuring Food Safety

Producing food that is wholesome and traceable is the most important thing we do.

[About Food Safety ][53]

## Join Our Team

We think Ocean Beauty is an incredible place to work and think you will like it too! Check the open
positions at our nine locations throughout the western United States.

[Learn More][54]

## Company Overview

A trusted name in the marine food industry, we Orchid Marine are one of India's leading exporters of
Fresh & Frozen Sea Food Products. We ensure to offer variety of seafood items, which is well
processed, hygienically packed & timely delivered. Our entire range of seafood remains fresh &
retains the flavor & nutritive quality. Driven by quality and customer satisfaction, we offer
various varieties of sea food products. We are empowered with skilled team of procurement,
production, quality assurance, marketing; we are able to deliver our products at competitive rates.
In a short period of time, we have developed strong and feasible distribution channels for effective
and smooth business operations. Our intense landing patern observation and well planned export
strategies have enabled us to identify and use cost effective solutions to offer products worldwide.
We have made tremendous efforts to source the high quality products from the sea catch & culture
pond to maximize our clients' satisfaction. Our Product Range We offer wide variety of sea food
products, which we source from reputed producers ensuring their quality and hygiene. A glimpse at
our range: Cuttle Fish Squid octopus Yellow Fin Tuna Skipjack Tuna Yellow Clam Grey Clam Bagai Green
Mussel Shark Sardine Indian Mackeral Reef Code Red Snapper Emperor White Snapper PUD Shrimp PD
Shrimp PTO Shrimp Tiger Prawn HLSO Shrimp Deep Sea Shrimp Blue Swimming Crab Three Spotted Crab
Skipjack Tuna Leather Jacket Mahi Mahi Snapper and many more Processing Raw material collected from
finishing harbors are brought in insulated vehicles to the raw material receiving section of the
factory. Bacteriological and organoleptic inspection is carried out by the quality control section
to ensure the acceptability of the material for production. After the raw material is approved for
production, they are washed and brought to the pre-processing unit. The material is pre-processed as
per the requirement, graded, weighed, washed and brought to the processing section where they are
checked thoroughly, weighed, glazed, filled in poly bags and made ready for freezing at -40 C. After
freezing, the product is packed and labeled accordingly and kept in the cold store at -20 C. Daily
organoleptic & bacteriological inspection is carried out on the finished products. After ensuring
the products meets all parameters of export worthy products, they are shipped in refrigerated
containers pre-cooled at -18 C. Our Quality Assurance Driven by an objective to deliver quality sea
food products, we ensure that our range comply with all national and international standards. We
have a separate quality control department and strict quality inspections are taken by the experts
right from the first stage of raw material collection to the final stage of packaging and shipment.
We also ensure hygienic packaging of our products and every consignment is thoroughly inspected and
certified by quality control department before packaging to ensure quality as per national and
international standards. We also have the facilities such as plate freezing, blast freezing and IQF
freezing. From processing to packaging, all processes are carried under hygiene and sanitary
conditions. We employ innovative quality control methods to keep our products fresh and healthy. We
strictly follow HACCP program. Why Us Our quality offerings have enabled us to attract maximum
number of customers on international level belonging to food industry, hotel industry, restaurant
and retail chain etc., due to following reasons: Credibility in every aspects Guaranteed freshness
and flavor of seafood. Safe, hygienic and on time product delivery. Ensured nutritive content.
Effective packaging. Competitive prices.

processed, hygienically packed & timely delivered. Our entire range of seafood remains fresh &
retains the flavor & nutritive quality. Driven by quality and customer satisfaction, we offer
various varieties of sea food products. We are empowered with skilled team of procurement,
production, quality assurance, marketing; we are able to deliver our products at competitive rates.
In a short period of time, we have developed strong and feasible distribution channels for effective
and smooth business operations. Our intense landing patern observation and well planned export
strategies have enabled us to identify and use cost effective solutions to offer products worldwide.
We have made tremendous efforts to source the high quality products from the sea catch & culture
pond to maximize our clients' satisfaction. Our Product Range We offer wide variety of sea food
products, which we source from reputed producers ensuring their quality and hygiene. A glimpse at
our range: Cuttle Fish Squid octopus Yellow Fin Tuna Skipjack Tuna Yellow Clam Grey Clam Bagai Green
Mussel Shark Sardine Indian Mackeral Reef Code Red Snapper Emperor White Snapper PUD Shrimp PD
Shrimp PTO Shrimp Tiger Prawn HLSO Shrimp Deep Sea Shrimp Blue Swimming Crab Three Spotted Crab
Skipjack Tuna Leather Jacket Mahi Mahi Snapper and many more Processing Raw material collected from
finishing harbors are brought in insulated vehicles to the raw material receiving section of the
factory. Bacteriological and organoleptic inspection is carried out by the quality control section
to ensure the acceptability of the material for production. After the raw material is approved for
production, they are washed and brought to the pre-processing unit. The material is pre-processed as
per the requirement, graded, weighed, washed and brought to the processing section where they are
checked thoroughly, weighed, glazed, filled in poly bags and made ready for freezing at -40 C. After
freezing, the product is packed and labeled accordingly and kept in the cold store at -20 C. Daily
organoleptic & bacteriological inspection is carried out on the finished products. After ensuring
the products meets all parameters of export worthy products, they are shipped in refrigerated
containers pre-cooled at -18 C. Our Quality Assurance Driven by an objective to deliver quality sea
food products, we ensure that our range comply with all national and international standards. We
have a separate quality control department and strict quality inspections are taken by the experts
right from the first stage of raw material collection to the final stage of packaging and shipment.
We also ensure hygienic packaging of our products and every consignment is thoroughly inspected and
certified by quality control department before packaging to ensure quality as per national and
international standards. We also have the facilities such as plate freezing, blast freezing and IQF
freezing. From processing to packaging, all processes are carried under hygiene and sanitary
conditions. We employ innovative quality control methods to keep our products fresh and healthy. We
strictly follow HACCP program. Why Us Our quality offerings have enabled us to attract maximum
number of customers on international level belonging to food industry, hotel industry, restaurant
and retail chain etc., due to following reasons: Credibility in every aspects Guaranteed freshness
and flavor of seafood. Safe, hygienic and on time product delivery. Ensured nutritive content.
Effective packaging. Competitive prices.

## The Story of Trident

Explore the journey of Trident Seafoods and discover who we are. From our commitment to sustainable
fishing practices to our dedication to delivering high-quality seafood, learn more about our mission
and values.

[Learn More][17]
[Chuck and Joe Bundrant standing together on a boat]

## Capabilities

With facilities and partnerships around the world, Trident Seafoods serves customers beyond just
fish. Our scalable production capabilities meet the needs of small, medium, and large businesses,
ensuring quality and efficiency at every level.

[Learn More][18]
[Worker standing on deck of catcher boat in Alaska]

## Join Our Team

Discover a range of rewarding career opportunities at Trident Seafoods that contribute to supporting
our vibrant community of fishermen. From the skilled trades to roles in Trident's Support Center,
join us in our mission to deliver high-quality, wild caught seafood from Alaska and make a positive
impact on the industry.

[Learn More][19]

We provide the freshest and highest-quality seafood available. Partnering with global leaders, we
deliver wild Alaska seafood to customers worldwide. Trust Trident Seafoods for exceptional taste and
sustainability.

# Anchored InAlaska

For more than 50 years, Trident Seafoods has led the way in responsible fishing in Alaska's pristine
waters. We are committed to our mission of sharing wild Alaska seafood with the world, never
compromising on quality or sustainability.

## The Story of Trident

Explore the journey of Trident Seafoods and discover who we are. From our commitment to sustainable
fishing practices to our dedication to delivering high-quality seafood, learn more about our mission
and values.

## Capabilities

With facilities and partnerships around the world, Trident Seafoods serves customers beyond just
fish. Our scalable production capabilities meet the needs of small, medium, and large businesses,
ensuring quality and efficiency at every level.

[Learn More][18]
[Worker standing on deck of catcher boat in Alaska]

## Join Our Team

Discover a range of rewarding career opportunities at Trident Seafoods that contribute to supporting
our vibrant community of fishermen. From the skilled trades to roles in Trident's Support Center,
join us in our mission to deliver high-quality, wild caught seafood from Alaska and make a positive
impact on the industry.

We provide the freshest and highest-quality seafood available. Partnering with global leaders, we
deliver wild Alaska seafood to customers worldwide. Trust Trident Seafoods for exceptional taste and
sustainability.

## Beyond the Ocean

With over a century of distribution experience, Ocean Beauty is proud to expand our offerings beyond
seafood. We now supply premium beef, pork, and poultry, bringing the same commitment to quality and
service that our customers have come to expect. Whether from land or sea, Ocean Beauty is your
partner in meeting diverse culinary needs. 

[Learn More][46]

## From Alaska, to the World.

Ocean Beauty has direct access to the top quality Alaska seafood that has always been at the heart
of our business. We also source products from the East Coast and around the world to offer a wide
array of customer favorites.

[View all Fresh & Frozen Seafood][47]
[Untitled design (14)]

## Creative Value-Added Seafood Solutions

In addition to a full line of fresh and frozen seafood, Ocean Beauty is committed to developing
products that makes selling seafood easy for retailers and simply delicious to prepare for
consumers. Our skin-packed portions and IQF seafood are ready for any recipe, and our creative meal
solutions pair top quality seafood with delicious accompaniments for easy meals in minutes.

[View Our Products][48]

## Distributing Seafood From Alaska and the World to Your Door

We operate seven wholesale distribution operations throughout the Western United States, and source
volumes of wild caught sustainable Alaska seafood through our sister company, OBI Seafoods.

[Find a Location Near You][49]
[Alaska-Pollock_S_P]

## Our Sustainability Commitment

We are dedicated to helping our customers meet their sustainability goals by producing products that
ensure healthy fish stocks, the environment that sustains them, and the communities that rely on
them.

[About Sustainability][50]
[icon-1]

### Committed to Quality

Whether it wears our label or yours, it’s our mission to deliver top quality seafood and value-added
products every time.

[About Quality ][51]
[icon-2]

### Sustaining Fisheries and Communities

All our facilities are eco-certified for a wide range of products from sustainable fisheries.

[About Sustainability ][52]
[icon-3]

### Ensuring Food Safety

Producing food that is wholesome and traceable is the most important thing we do.

[About Food Safety ][53]

## Join Our Team

We think Ocean Beauty is an incredible place to work and think you will like it too! Check the open
positions at our nine locations throughout the western United States.

[Learn More][54]

impact on the industry.

[ About Us ][22]

challenges. Seafood stakeholders need clear information and practical guidance to take action to
address these problems. FishWise is a seafood industry compass, providing innovative market-based
tools and expertise in sustainability services, human rights action, and traceability best
practices.

### Welcome to John Asia International (Pvt) Ltd

Leading the seafood export industry from Sri Lanka since 2016, we deliver premium, 100% wild-caught
seafood to customers worldwide. Committed to quality and sustainability, we adhere to the highest
standards of hygiene and compliance. Contact us to customize your order and experience the best in
fresh seafood exports.

### Our Products

We export a premium selection of seafood, including red snapper, mahi mahi, grouper, yellowfin tuna,
and swordfish. Our products are sourced with the highest quality standards to ensure exceptional
freshness and flavor, making them perfect for a range of culinary creations.

[Our Products][31]

### About Us

John Asia International (Pvt) Ltd, based in Sri Lanka, has been a leading seafood exporter since
2016. Our advanced processing plant adheres to strict hygiene standards and international
certifications, ensuring premium quality seafood for our global customers.

[Who we are][32]

### Our certificates

Our processing facilities are certified with international standards, including Friend of the Sea,
Dolphin Safe, BRCGS (A Grade), ISO 22000:2018, HACCP, and GMP. These certifications ensure that our
seafood products meet the highest quality, safety, and environmental standards.

[Our Certificates][33]

## Company Overview

A trusted name in the marine food industry, we Orchid Marine are one of India's leading exporters of
Fresh & Frozen Sea Food Products. We ensure to offer variety of seafood items, which is well
processed, hygienically packed & timely delivered. Our entire range of seafood remains fresh &
retains the flavor & nutritive quality. Driven by quality and customer satisfaction, we offer
various varieties of sea food products. We are empowered with skilled team of procurement,
production, quality assurance, marketing; we are able to deliver our products at competitive rates.
In a short period of time, we have developed strong and feasible distribution channels for effective
and smooth business operations. Our intense landing patern observation and well planned export
strategies have enabled us to identify and use cost effective solutions to offer products worldwide.
We have made tremendous efforts to source the high quality products from the sea catch & culture
pond to maximize our clients' satisfaction. Our Product Range We offer wide variety of sea food
products, which we source from reputed producers ensuring their quality and hygiene. A glimpse at
our range: Cuttle Fish Squid octopus Yellow Fin Tuna Skipjack Tuna Yellow Clam Grey Clam Bagai Green
Mussel Shark Sardine Indian Mackeral Reef Code Red Snapper Emperor White Snapper PUD Shrimp PD
Shrimp PTO Shrimp Tiger Prawn HLSO Shrimp Deep Sea Shrimp Blue Swimming Crab Three Spotted Crab
Skipjack Tuna Leather Jacket Mahi Mahi Snapper and many more Processing Raw material collected from
finishing harbors are brought in insulated vehicles to the raw material receiving section of the
factory. Bacteriological and organoleptic inspection is carried out by the quality control section
to ensure the acceptability of the material for production. After the raw material is approved for
production, they are washed and brought to the pre-processing unit. The material is pre-processed as
per the requirement, graded, weighed, washed and brought to the processing section where they are
checked thoroughly, weighed, glazed, filled in poly bags and made ready for freezing at -40 C. After
freezing, the product is packed and labeled accordingly and kept in the cold store at -20 C. Daily
organoleptic & bacteriological inspection is carried out on the finished products. After ensuring
the products meets all parameters of export worthy products, they are shipped in refrigerated
containers pre-cooled at -18 C. Our Quality Assurance Driven by an objective to deliver quality sea
food products, we ensure that our range comply with all national and international standards. We
have a separate quality control department and strict quality inspections are taken by the experts
right from the first stage of raw material collection to the final stage of packaging and shipment.
We also ensure hygienic packaging of our products and every consignment is thoroughly inspected and
certified by quality control department before packaging to ensure quality as per national and
international standards. We also have the facilities such as plate freezing, blast freezing and IQF
freezing. From processing to packaging, all processes are carried under hygiene and sanitary
conditions. We employ innovative quality control methods to keep our products fresh and healthy. We
strictly follow HACCP program. Why Us Our quality offerings have enabled us to attract maximum
number of customers on international level belonging to food industry, hotel industry, restaurant
and retail chain etc., due to following reasons: Credibility in every aspects Guaranteed freshness
and flavor of seafood. Safe, hygienic and on time product delivery. Ensured nutritive content.
Effective packaging. Competitive prices.

### [The Parties to the Nauru Agreement][47]

The Parties to the Nauru Agreement (PNA) control the world's largest sustainable tuna purse seine
fishery.

PNA Members are Federated States of Micronesia, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Nauru, Palau, Papua New
Guinea, Solomon Islands and Tuvalu.

Global leaders in tuna conservation and management, many PNA conservation measures are world firsts
– such as high seas closures to fishing, controls on Fish Aggregating Devices (FADs), protection for
whale sharks and the 100% coverage of purse seine fishing vessels with observers. No dolphins are
caught in PNA waters and the PNA is actively involved in limiting bycatch of other species. [Read
more][48]

## Agro | Marine | Export

Qezla Industries

Qezla Industries is a leading Indian manufacturer, global sourcing partner, online wholesale trader,
and ship chandler based in Kakinada, a key hub on India’s east coast for agriculture and marine
trade. We specialize in agricultural commodities, marine foods, industrial supplies, and vessel
provisioning, serving wholesale and international export markets through reliable sourcing, strict
quality control, and efficient logistics. With a strong focus on quality, consistency, and value,
Qezla delivers dependable products and seamless supply solutions to clients worldwide.

We export a diverse range of food and agro products to more than 20 countries across the globe.

## An environmental nonprofit organization inspiring change so people and nature thrive

At Rare, we believe in people—and in the power of community to ignite change and drive action. We
bring together behavioral science, local leadership, and global partnerships to create scalable,
lasting solutions for environmental conservation.

 

### Rare’s Global Impact
* [100+]

Rare invests in people and nature to solve our greatest conservation and development challenges. We
partner with local leaders, individuals, and their communities to help them co-manage, protect, and

# Sustainable Tuna

## Milestones

[milestones-2011]

## 2011

Work towards building sustainable tuna fisheries began with the launch of the Partnership Program
Towards Sustainable Tuna (PPTST). Worked with 28 communities along Mindoro Strait.

[milestone-2012]

## 2012

WWF-Philippines launches a Fisheries Improvement Project in the Lagonoy Gulf and Mindoro Strait.
Groundwork towards MSC certification begins.

[milestone]

## 2014

Founded the Occidental Mindoro Federation of Tuna Fishers Association (OMFTFA).

[milestone-2014-2]

## 2014

Founded the Gulf of Lagonoy Tuna Fishers Federation, Inc. (GLTFFI).

[milestone-2015]

## 2015

The Lagonoy Gulf IFARMC was first formed, convened and strengthened.

[milestone-2017]

## 2017

Launched the Sustainable Tuna Partnership 1 program. Assisted in organizing seven Fisheries and
Aquatic Resource Management Councils (FARMCs) across Mindoro.

[milestone-2017-2]

## 2017

Launched the Lagonoy Gulf Tuna Management Plan.

[milestone-2017-3]

## 2017

Produced the award-winning short film Nonoy and the Sea Monster, shot on location in Catanduanes.

[milestone-2019]

## 2019

Launched the Mindoro Tuna Management Plan.

[milestone-2020]

## 2020

Founded the Philippine Tuna Handline Partnership (PTHP) – a coalition of small-scale tuna fisherfolk
and tuna processors that serve as a client group through which fishers could ship their products to
local and international markets.

[milestone-2021]

## 2021

PTHP is awarded the first ever Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) Certification in the Philippines in
an important milestone towards sustainable fisheries.

[milestone-2021-2]

## 2021

Launched the Sustainable Tuna Partnership 2 (STP2) project

[milestone-2022]

## 2022

Launched Project Buhay: Tuna Habambuhay, Dagdag Hanapbuhay

## Discover Our Projects

[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Sustainable Tuna Partnership On-going

STP1 improved fishers’ government representation, financial management and business skills. In its
second phase, STP2 has gone regional, lobbying for Yellowfin Tuna harvest control rules and
strategies for the Western and Central Pacific Ocean.
[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Project Buhay On-going

Emerging from a decade of building sustainable tuna fisheries in Bicol and Mindoro, Project Buhay
explores ways to make tuna fishing in Occidental Mindoro both sustainable and equitable
[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Fish Forward

A collaboration among 17 partners in 17 countries, including the Philippines, to integrate
sustainable seafood in policies, practices, products and purchases.
[giving fish]

### Partnership Program Towards Sustainable Tuna

The first Fishery Improvement Project (FIP) for artisanal fisheries in the Philippines that paved
the way to achieve the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) certification in 2021.

### The following companies and research institutes take part in this project in which state of the
### art research combines with industrial knowledge and technological expertise to develop
### innovative monitoring and decision making systems to improve tuna fisheries sustainability.

[[Marine Instruments]][33]

###### Buoys manufacturing, advanced visualization and route optimization heuristics using
###### forecasted fish distribution.

[[AZTI]][34]

###### Species distribution forecasting, information fusion and machine learning.

[[Newcastle University]][35]

###### Energy efficiency using machine learning and considering environmental conditions with
###### experience in different types of fishing and shipping vessels

###### Sensors, engines and software distributor for fishing and shipping industry.

[[Mardis]][36]

###### Provider of sensors for engines, propulsion system and fuel consumption monitoring software.

[[SINTEF]][37]

###### Data collection from heterogeneous systems such as fishing vessels.

[[Universidad del País Vasco]][38]

###### Energy efficiency statistical analysis with specific knowhow of tuna vessels engines and
###### data.

[[Echebastar]][39]

###### Basque fishing company based in Bermeo that harvests tuna with its fleet of 6 purse seiners.

# About
* **TITLE:** SUSTUNTECH – Using advanced Earth observation tools to promote sustainable tuna fishing
* **PROGRAMME (S): **[**H2020-EU.3.5. – SOCIETAL CHALLENGES – Climate action, Environment, Resource
  Efficiency and Raw Materials** ][40]MAIN PROGRAMME **[H2020-EU.3.5.5. – Developing comprehensive
  and sustained global environmental observation and information systems][41]**
* **TOTAL COST **€ 3 035 463,35
* **EU contribution:** € 2 618 968,11
* **Start date:** 1 May 2020
* **End date: **30 April 2024
* **Coordinated by: **MARINE INSTRUMENTS SA

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

want your restaurant to be as authentic as possible, then you might also want to get the tuna
directly from Japan factory. That way the tuna you use in your restaurant will be the same tuna as
the one used by sushi restaurant in Japan.
Furthermore [**tuna factory**][47] in Japan already know about the tuna specification which needed
to create tuna sushi. Thus they will create their product so it will be suitable to be use to make
sushi. So you can be sure with the quality of the product that they create for your sushi
restaurant. Furthermore they will create their product with suitable weight thus you can use one
product at a time without have to get too much waste. Especially since sushi is served in raw
condition, thus you cannot reuse product which you already used half before, thus product sizing is
really important.

which caught from Japan Sea. This means the tuna fish is caught by the Japanese fishermen before
being brought into the factory. Those fishermen should already know that most of the tuna fish that
they caught will be used to create the sushi dishes which they also love. Thus they will treat their
catch with care since they want to ensure the quality of the [frozen tuna fish][48]** **that they
caught will be the highest possible.

which tuna meat quality is the best use for making tuna sushi. Thus you can trust their grader to
give you the best and highest quality tuna meat for your sushi restaurant.

### [The Parties to the Nauru Agreement][47]

The Parties to the Nauru Agreement (PNA) control the world's largest sustainable tuna purse seine
fishery.

PNA Members are Federated States of Micronesia, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Nauru, Palau, Papua New
Guinea, Solomon Islands and Tuvalu.

Global leaders in tuna conservation and management, many PNA conservation measures are world firsts
– such as high seas closures to fishing, controls on Fish Aggregating Devices (FADs), protection for
whale sharks and the 100% coverage of purse seine fishing vessels with observers. No dolphins are
caught in PNA waters and the PNA is actively involved in limiting bycatch of other species. [Read
more][48]

## Agro | Marine | Export

Qezla Industries

Qezla Industries is a leading Indian manufacturer, global sourcing partner, online wholesale trader,
and ship chandler based in Kakinada, a key hub on India’s east coast for agriculture and marine
trade. We specialize in agricultural commodities, marine foods, industrial supplies, and vessel
provisioning, serving wholesale and international export markets through reliable sourcing, strict
quality control, and efficient logistics. With a strong focus on quality, consistency, and value,
Qezla delivers dependable products and seamless supply solutions to clients worldwide.

We export a diverse range of food and agro products to more than 20 countries across the globe.

# Sustainable Tuna

## Milestones

[milestones-2011]

## 2011

Work towards building sustainable tuna fisheries began with the launch of the Partnership Program
Towards Sustainable Tuna (PPTST). Worked with 28 communities along Mindoro Strait.

[milestone-2012]

## 2012

WWF-Philippines launches a Fisheries Improvement Project in the Lagonoy Gulf and Mindoro Strait.
Groundwork towards MSC certification begins.

[milestone]

## 2014

Founded the Occidental Mindoro Federation of Tuna Fishers Association (OMFTFA).

[milestone-2014-2]

## 2014

Founded the Gulf of Lagonoy Tuna Fishers Federation, Inc. (GLTFFI).

[milestone-2015]

## 2015

The Lagonoy Gulf IFARMC was first formed, convened and strengthened.

[milestone-2017]

## 2017

Launched the Sustainable Tuna Partnership 1 program. Assisted in organizing seven Fisheries and
Aquatic Resource Management Councils (FARMCs) across Mindoro.

[milestone-2017-2]

## 2017

Launched the Lagonoy Gulf Tuna Management Plan.

[milestone-2017-3]

## 2017

Produced the award-winning short film Nonoy and the Sea Monster, shot on location in Catanduanes.

[milestone-2019]

## 2019

Launched the Mindoro Tuna Management Plan.

[milestone-2020]

## 2020

Founded the Philippine Tuna Handline Partnership (PTHP) – a coalition of small-scale tuna fisherfolk
and tuna processors that serve as a client group through which fishers could ship their products to
local and international markets.

[milestone-2021]

## 2021

PTHP is awarded the first ever Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) Certification in the Philippines in
an important milestone towards sustainable fisheries.

[milestone-2021-2]

## 2021

Launched the Sustainable Tuna Partnership 2 (STP2) project

[milestone-2022]

## 2022

Launched Project Buhay: Tuna Habambuhay, Dagdag Hanapbuhay

## Discover Our Projects

[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Sustainable Tuna Partnership On-going

STP1 improved fishers’ government representation, financial management and business skills. In its
second phase, STP2 has gone regional, lobbying for Yellowfin Tuna harvest control rules and
strategies for the Western and Central Pacific Ocean.
[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Project Buhay On-going

Emerging from a decade of building sustainable tuna fisheries in Bicol and Mindoro, Project Buhay
explores ways to make tuna fishing in Occidental Mindoro both sustainable and equitable
[Sustainable Tuna Partnership]

### Fish Forward

A collaboration among 17 partners in 17 countries, including the Philippines, to integrate
sustainable seafood in policies, practices, products and purchases.
[giving fish]

### Partnership Program Towards Sustainable Tuna

The first Fishery Improvement Project (FIP) for artisanal fisheries in the Philippines that paved
the way to achieve the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) certification in 2021.

### The following companies and research institutes take part in this project in which state of the
### art research combines with industrial knowledge and technological expertise to develop
### innovative monitoring and decision making systems to improve tuna fisheries sustainability.

[[Marine Instruments]][33]

###### Buoys manufacturing, advanced visualization and route optimization heuristics using
###### forecasted fish distribution.

[[AZTI]][34]

###### Species distribution forecasting, information fusion and machine learning.

[[Newcastle University]][35]

###### Energy efficiency using machine learning and considering environmental conditions with
###### experience in different types of fishing and shipping vessels

###### Sensors, engines and software distributor for fishing and shipping industry.

[[Mardis]][36]

###### Provider of sensors for engines, propulsion system and fuel consumption monitoring software.

[[SINTEF]][37]

###### Data collection from heterogeneous systems such as fishing vessels.

[[Universidad del País Vasco]][38]

###### Energy efficiency statistical analysis with specific knowhow of tuna vessels engines and
###### data.

[[Echebastar]][39]

###### Basque fishing company based in Bermeo that harvests tuna with its fleet of 6 purse seiners.

# About
* **TITLE:** SUSTUNTECH – Using advanced Earth observation tools to promote sustainable tuna fishing

  Efficiency and Raw Materials** ][40]MAIN PROGRAMME **[H2020-EU.3.5.5. – Developing comprehensive
  and sustained global environmental observation and information systems][41]**
* **TOTAL COST **€ 3 035 463,35
* **EU contribution:** € 2 618 968,11
* **Start date:** 1 May 2020
* **End date: **30 April 2024
* **Coordinated by: **MARINE INSTRUMENTS SA

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

globally.
